_note: Technical Papers and articles. Add a paper: write _content/<slug>.md (start at '## Abstract'; no title or author lines), add an entry at the END of 'papers' WITHOUT a 'no' (papers are not numbered), then run: python3 papers/_build.py. Articles are Jekyll posts in _posts/; list each in 'articles' (title, url, date, tags, summary). Never reuse a slug. Each paper has a 'group' (Aerodynamics, Energy & Power, Flexible Packaging & Gravure, General Studies); the index lists papers under these headings.

papers.title: Exoskeletons: From Early Patents to Medical, Industrial and Consumer Markets
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: From Yagn's 1890 spring patent and GE's Hardiman to FDA-cleared walking suits, factory shoulder vests and consumer hip-assist devices: the history, the path to market, today's major makers with links, and where each application is heading.

papers.title: Predicting Blown PE Film Properties and Cost by the Method of Mixtures, and Where It Fails
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Blown PE films, Part 1 of 2. A two-level method of mixtures for blended layers and three-layer coextrusions: what adds up (density, stiffness), what does not (dart, tear) and why, worked structures, typical cost per kg and per m², and a companion offline calculator. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Heat-Sealing Windows for Five Common Pouch Laminates
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Starting jaw temperature, dwell and pressure for five common bag and pouch structures across their thickness ranges, why a PET outer layer doubles the sealing window, how bag-making machines evolved from cams to servo, today's speed benchmarks, and what recyclable mono-material films will change. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Seven Inks Instead of Spot Colours: Extended Colour Gamut in Gravure
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How a fixed set of seven process inks (CMYKOGV) lets gravure converters replace spot colours: the history from CMY to Hexachrome, Opaltone and today's ECG, the advantages, how it cuts colour count and ink changes, alternative schemes, limitations, an adoption roadmap and 2024–2026 trends. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: LDPE Sealant Films for Lamination: Process Windows, Additives and the Shift to All-PE
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How LDPE became the sealant web of laminated packs and how it has evolved: blow-up ratio and process windows, the temperature at each station of the line, lamination-grade properties, a dedicated review of additives from metallocene PE and fillers to slip and PFAS-free processing aids, and the move to all-PE recyclable laminates. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Web Tension in Gravure Presses: Control Methods and Starting Values from Unwind to Rewind
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How gravure presses moved from hand-set brakes and line shafts to dancers, load cells and electronic line shafts, and starting tension values for BOPET, BOPP, CPP, PE, nylon, shrink film, foil, paper and board by thickness and web width, zone by zone from unwind to rewind taper. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: From Line Shaft to Shaftless: The Evolution of Gravure Press Drives
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How rotogravure presses went from one steel line shaft with bevel-gear take-offs to shaftless servo drives on a virtual master: the history, why the shaft limited register, how take-off backlash is controlled, a side-by-side comparison, retrofit paths for converters, and current trends. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Beyond the Method of Mixtures: Process Corrections for Blown PE Film Properties
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Blown PE films, Part 2 of 2. How BUR, draw-down ratio, die gap, frost-line or stalk height and melt fracture change tear, dart and tensile balance; family-specific correction laws applied before the mixture rules of the method-of-mixtures paper, operating windows, a sharkskin check and suggested BUR and die gap for common recipes. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Why Great Companies Fall: Seventeen Corporate Histories and Their Share-Price Signatures
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Nokia, Kodak, GE, Enron, Lehman, Intel, Boeing, Sears, Satyam, Jet Airways, RCom, Kingfisher, DHFL, Yes Bank and Hindustan Motors, with Apple and IBM as comebacks: ten causes of decline, share prices lined up from each peak, why fraud and debt collapses take a year while disruption takes a decade, an engineering view of failure modes and an early-warning checklist. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Is the Thirukkural Timeless? Testing the Ulaga Pothu Marai Against Past, Present and Future
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Is the Thirukkural really valid for past, present and future? All 133 chapters are tested in three tiers (66.9 % hold as written, 28.6 % hold once the setting is translated, 4.5 % are era-bound); a word survey shows the text never names Tamil, a place, a king or a sect; 77 couplets in Tamil with modern translations are read across twelve domains; the dated parts are examined openly; and the Kural is read against AI, misinformation, climate, ageing and automation. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Can Efficiency Offset the Data-Centre Power Surge?
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Data-centre electricity is set to more than double to about 945 TWh by 2030. Layer by layer, from software and servers to cooling, power conversion and the grid, sixteen worked examples show how much better operation and upgrades can win back, with sections on instrumentation, India and Chennai, a step-by-step retrofit of a Chennai colocation hall, and an estimate that efficiency could offset one-third to two-thirds of the growth. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Keeping the Lights On: Grid Management Worldwide, Blackout Lessons and India's Path
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How the world keeps supply and demand in balance every second: the physics and control hierarchy, 140 years of grid history, how the US, Europe, China, Australia and India organise their grids, lessons from six major blackouts, today's problems (demand growth, connection queues, transformer shortages, falling inertia, ramps, voltage control, large loads) and the tools and future improvements, with a detailed India section and 27 worked calculations. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Beyond Three Dimensions: A Chronological Review of Extra-Dimension Theories
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: From Riemann's 1854 lecture to the swampland and the micron-sized 'dark dimension' of 2022-2025: the key papers on higher dimensions in order, what each argued, assumed and ran into, the three experiments that have found none, and how the popular 0D-8D ladder maps onto the real literature. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: From Section Drag to Mission Performance: Airfoil Choice Across Fixed-Wing and Rotary Aircraft
papers.short: From section drag to mission performance
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How the drag of an airfoil section - minimum drag, drag bucket, Reynolds-number and transition effects, drag divergence and wave drag - carries through to range, endurance, climb, manoeuvre and hover performance of transports, turboprops, sailplanes, drones, fighters, helicopters, tiltrotors and multicopters. Ten worked examples with 20 charts quantify the sensitivities, from 2.3 % transport fuel per 10 % wing profile drag to 127 kg of hot-and-high hover payload lost to blade erosion. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Making XFOIL Converge: Accuracy, Optimisation and the Multi-Element Limit
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: The history of Drela's XFOIL and today's family of ports, physics branches, re-implementations and surrogates; the full governing equations of version 6.99; and 13 356 operating-point solutions that measure where it fails: one point in ten fails at default settings, failed points are often within 0.1 % of the answer, one failure can poison a whole sweep, and drag shifts ±10 % with the transition parameter. Sixteen improvements are proposed, from state restoration and smooth transition to adjoint gradients, and a multi-element panel study shows why panel methods can size high-lift systems but cannot predict their maximum lift. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: AVL in Practice: Strengths, Limits and Extensions of the Athena Vortex Lattice Code
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: How MIT's AVL grew from a 1988 Project Athena teaching code into the standard tool for stability and control derivatives of aircraft and UAVs: the vortex-lattice lineage from Prandtl and Falkner, AVL's release history to 3.40b, its formulation and derivative workflow, current use in teaching, PX4 and design frameworks, extensions by others (OptVL, JVL, ASWING, decambering, slipstream VLMs), a limitations checklist and a roadmap. Two worked examples, a conventional UAV and a tailless flying wing, give validated derivatives, neutral points, modes, sensitivities and a surface-by-surface breakdown. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

papers.title: Inside XROTOR: A Code Review of the Propeller Lifting-Line Program
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Drela and Youngren's propeller code reviewed end to end: the classical vortex theory behind it, its version history and family (QPROP, DFDC, CROTOR, ports), the full equations of its three wake models, equivalent propeller and section model, and 18 findings from a line-by-line review of the Fortran source. About 2 600 operating points from a double-precision port show graded momentum over-predicting thrust by 6 % at advance ratio 0.3 and 18 % at 0.5 for two blades, root loading set by the hub model, and two fixable convergence traps: the circulation filter and the Mach-dependent stall limits. Fifteen improvements are proposed. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

articles.title: Salt-Resistant Flush Valve Design for Hard-Water Regions
articles.author: K Vijay Anand
articles.summary: Why washer-type flush valves leak in hard-water regions, a survey of existing valve families, and a proposed knife-edge stainless seat with a PTFE-coated disc, backed by a force balance, a salt-bridging model and a water-wastage projection, with Python source for every figure. PDF in IEEE two-column format.

articles.title: The Earth–Jupiter Dance: How Two Planets Draw a Star in Space
articles.author: K Vijay Anand
articles.summary: Draw a line between Earth and Jupiter every day for twelve years and an eleven-pointed star appears: the geometry and mathematics behind the pattern, built step by step with Python code to reproduce and extend it.
